architecture: GEA-Net: relation-specific pin/component and pin/observed-wire-group message passing + edge decoder

training.supervision: source net membership with synthetic 2.5-7 pixel endpoint displacement; oracle symbols and wires; not end-to-end performance

evaluation: page-held-out oracle/jitter validation used for checkpoint and threshold selection; not independent end-to-end test
policy: negative veto only; uncertain predictions abstain; all image/topology/circuit gates retained
